name: Medicaid Ready
target_user: Adult children and spouses placing a parent in nursing or memory care who must file a long-term-care Medicaid application
one_liner: Builds a nursing-home Medicaid application packet from five years of statements, with flagged transfers and drafted explanation letters.
price_hypothesis: $349 one-time per applicant (packet plus 90 days of request tracking); free flagged-items preview
model_cost_per_user_month: $4.3 per case, one-time (about $1.4/month over a 90-day case)

name: Retirement Desk
target_user: People retiring or turning 65, plus a spouse or adult child helping, including widowed spouses taking over paperwork
one_liner: A case manager for the year around retirement or turning 65: deadlines, documents, forms, claims and appeals.
price_hypothesis: $149 one-time for a 12-month case; free personal deadline calendar

name: Parent Mail Desk
target_user: Adult children who handle an aging parent's mail, bills and phone calls, often sharing the load with siblings
one_liner: A parent texts a photo of any letter; AI explains it and gives the adult child a one-tap action.
price_hypothesis: $14.99/month per family (one parent, up to four relatives); first scam check free
model_cost_per_user_month: $0.22 model plus about $1.5 for text messages and a phone number

name: Grant Ledger
target_user: Small nonprofits ($250K to $5M budgets) with 2 to 10 restricted grants, a part-time bookkeeper or finance lead, and QuickBooks Online
one_liner: Allocates every nonprofit expense to the right grant from the award agreement and drafts funder and board reports.
price_hypothesis: $149/month per organization (up to 5 grants), +$29 per extra grant

name: Haul Paid
target_user: Owner-operators and 1-10 truck carriers hauling for freight brokers
one_liner: Collects detention, layover and short-pays for small carriers by turning rate cons, BOLs and ELD logs into escalating claims.
price_hypothesis: 20% of money recovered, nothing if nothing is recovered

name: Shoebox
target_user: HSA holders who pay medical costs out of pocket now and plan to reimburse themselves years later
one_liner: Turns a decade of medical bills and EOBs into matched, audit-ready proof for tax-free HSA reimbursement.
price_hypothesis: $19/year after 25 free documents; $49 one-time backlog import and audit binder
model_cost_per_user_month: $0.07 steady state; $5.2 one-time for a 250-document backlog

name: Authority Guard
target_user: Owner-operators and 1-10 truck carriers with their own MC authority
one_liner: Watches a small carrier's FMCSA authority, insurance filings and deadlines daily, and walks the owner through the fix.
price_hypothesis: $12/month per carrier

name: Do It With Me
target_user: Adult children who set up and support a parent aged 70 or more who struggles with phone, bank and health-portal tasks
one_liner: A voice guide walks an older parent through bank and portal tasks, refuses scam-like steps, and calls the child.
price_hypothesis: $14.99/month per parent device with 60 guided minutes included; first two routines free
model_cost_per_user_month: $1.4 on Gemini Live voice, up to $3.4 on GPT Live

name: Closeout Copilot
target_user: Commercial HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops serving national accounts through facility-management portals
one_liner: Turns a tech's photos and voice note into the exact closeout each facility-management portal demands.
price_hypothesis: $149/month per shop (up to 5 techs)

name: Job Walk
target_user: Residential HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops with 1-10 techs on Jobber or Housecall Pro
one_liner: Tech talks while walking the job and snaps photos; AI returns good-better-best estimates from the shop's price book.
price_hypothesis: $99/month per shop (up to 3 techs)

name: Backlog Books
target_user: Owners and bookkeepers facing 3 to 24 months of unreconciled books before a tax, loan, sale or divorce deadline
one_liner: Turns months of unreconciled statements into a categorized, evidence-linked ledger and accountant-ready export at a fixed price per month.
price_hypothesis: $79 per backlog month (up to 150 transactions), one-time; optional accountant review add-on

name: Scope Guard
target_user: Small remodelers and trade contractors who work from signed estimates
one_liner: Turns client texts and site voice notes into priced change orders signed before the extra work starts.
price_hypothesis: $39/month per contractor

name: Bill Detective
target_user: Patients and family caregivers holding a medical bill that does not match the insurer's explanation of benefits
one_liner: Reconciles medical bills against EOBs line by line, then drafts the letters and appeals to fix them.
price_hypothesis: $39 per case with letters; $99 with certified mail and a hold-queue call
model_cost_per_user_month: $0.40 per case without voice; about $4.2 with one hour-long hold call
gross_margin: 95% without voice, 85% with a hold call

name: Books Second Opinion
target_user: Owners who let AI or a junior keep the books, and bookkeeping firms that review clients' QuickBooks Online or Xero files
one_liner: Audits AI-kept or human-kept QuickBooks and Xero books monthly and writes a CPA-ready memo with proposed journal entries.
price_hypothesis: $49/month per company; $29 per client per month for bookkeeping firms

name: Fix Desk
target_user: Self-managing landlords with 2-50 doors and their own vendors
one_liner: Text-and-voice maintenance line that triages tenant requests and books a landlord's own vendors, with one-tap owner approval.
price_hypothesis: $15/month flat for up to 10 doors

name: Gap Filler
target_user: Independent stylists and small salon owners with 1-4 chairs
one_liner: Compacts a stylist's day by offering clients earlier or later slots and filling cancellations from a waitlist.
price_hypothesis: $19/month per stylist account

name: Food Cost Buddy
target_user: Independent restaurants under $1M revenue whose owners reconcile supplier invoices against POS sales by hand
one_liner: Text a photo of a supplier invoice; get updated recipe costs, price-jump alerts and a weekly reconciliation.
price_hypothesis: $49/month per location (MarginEdge lists about $350)

name: Forward-to-Post
target_user: Owners of one-to-ten person businesses on QuickBooks, Xero, Jobber, Buildium or Vagaro who re-key receipts and work orders
one_liner: Forward receipts, invoices and work orders; they post to the right record in your existing software and learn corrections.
price_hypothesis: $29/month per business

name: Service Chargebacks
target_user: Service businesses (salons, trades, studios) taking card payments on Stripe or Square with job records in Jobber, Vagaro or similar
one_liner: Builds reason-code-specific chargeback evidence packets from job records for salons, trades and studios paid by card.
price_hypothesis: $19/month plus 10% of recovered disputes (market success fees run 10% to 25%)

name: Wholesale Desk
target_user: Small Shopify brands with 5 to 50 wholesale accounts that order by email, PDF or chat on net terms
one_liner: Turns wholesale purchase orders arriving by email, PDF or chat into checked Shopify draft orders and net-terms invoices.
price_hypothesis: $49/month per store, free tier at 5 POs a month (market: free to $99)
